authority.basis: operator explicit invocation of the product image-show primitive
authority.note: image-show authority is per-invocation. This record does not authorize a replay.

source_image.content: magenta smile (9 px), two cyan eyes (4 px at row 5 cols 4-5 and 10-11), and a 3 px yellow L-shaped asymmetry mark at rows/cols (1,1) (1,2) (2,1), top-left

operation_count_note: The Host recorded two completed operations 12.5 s apart with distinct operation ids. The operator confirmed on 2026-09-09 that they invoked image-show twice; both were separate deliberate invocations, each performing exactly one connection. RESOLVED: not an automatic retry, and consistent with the no-retry boundary in the Host and CLI.

operator_observation.visual_result: smile visible on the exact unit, reading upright
operator_observation.orientation_evidence: Operator reports exactly 3 yellow pixels in the top-left corner, matching the fixture's 3 px L-shaped mark at (1,1) (1,2) (2,1). The corner and pixel count exclude horizontal flip, vertical flip and 180 deg rotation; the image reading as an upright smile excludes the transpose, anti-transpose, 90 deg and 270 deg cases. All eight dihedral orientations are therefore excluded.
operator_observation.colors_evidence: Yellow renders as yellow. Magenta and cyan rendition were not separately reported.
operator_observation.note: Row-major top-left-origin pixel geometry is now physically confirmed end to end.

findings.statement: The wrapped 0x44 ACK payload byte differs across identical successful image sends: 0x12 (M5 diagnostic, different image), 0x75 and 0xF0 (this record, byte-identical image packet twice). It is therefore not a fixed success code and must not be validated as one.
findings.not_claimed: No semantic meaning is assigned. It may be a counter, sequence, echo or unrelated state; nothing in the current evidence distinguishes these.
findings.enforced_by: cli/openditoo.py validates ok/packetCount/imagePacketSha256/paletteColors/connectionsAttempted/socketClosed/retry and deliberately does not require a specific ackPayloadHex.

findings.statement: exact local 16x16 PNG -> deterministic RGB888 decode -> stock-derived image packet -> Python/C# hash agreement -> authenticated fixed-target Host -> Ditoo produced a visible custom frame, with the Host's stage diagnostics reporting ack and a clean close.

The encoder's row-major, top-left-origin 16x16 pixel geometry is physically correct on the exact unit: a 3 px asymmetry mark placed at rows 1-2 / columns 1-2 of the source PNG appeared in the top-left corner of the device, with the frame reading upright.
findings.not_claimed: Nothing about persistence, refresh behaviour, or the device's own scan order below the application layer.
